name: Fizz
title: the Tidal Trickster

Q.name: Urchin Strike
Q.description: Fizz dashes through an enemy, dealing 1×AD physical damage plus ? + 0.55×AP magic damage.
Q.summary: Fizz dashes through his target, dealing magic damage and applying on hit effects.

W.name: Seastone Trident
W.description: Passive: Fizz's Attacks cause his enemies to bleed, dealing 30/45/60/75/90 + 0.25×AP magic damage over 3 seconds. Active: Fizz's next Attack deals an additional 50/75/100/125/150 + 0.45×AP magic damage. If this Attack kills its target, Fizz refunds 30/40/50/60/70 Mana and reduces the cooldown of this Ability to 1 second. If it does not kill, Fizz's Attacks deal an additional 20/25/30/35/40 + 0.3×AP magic damage for 5 seconds.
W.summary: Fizz's attacks bleed his enemies, dealing magic damage over several seconds. Fizz can empower his next attack to deal bonus damage and empower his further attacks for a short time.

E.name: Playful / Trickster
E.description: Fizz hops onto his trident, becoming Untargetable for 0.75 seconds, after which he deals 80/130/180/230/280 + 0.95×AP magic damage to nearby enemies and Slows them by 40/45/50/55.0/60% for 2 seconds. Fizz can Recast this Ability while Untargetable to dash again, which ends the effect early, deals damage in a smaller area, and doesn't Slow.
E.summary: Fizz hops into the air, landing gracefully upon his spear and becoming untargetable. From this position, Fizz can either slam the ground or choose to jump again before smashing back down.

R.name: Chum the Waters
R.description: Fizz launches a fish that attaches to the first champion hit. The victim is afflicted with True Sight and Slowed by between 40% to 80% based on how far the fish travelled before attaching. After 2 seconds a shark erupts on the target, Knocking Up the target with the fish for 1 second, Knocking Back everything else, and dealing between 180/300/420 + 0.6×AP to (180/300/420 + 0.6×AP) × 1.5 magic damage based on how far the fish travelled before attaching.
R.summary: Fizz tosses a fish in a direction that attaches to any champion that touches it, slowing the target. After a short delay, a shark erupts from the ground, knocking up the target and knocking any nearby enemies aside. All enemies hit are dealt magic damage and slowed.

Passive.name: Nimble Fighter
Passive.description: Fizz can move through units and takes a flat amount of reduced damage from all sources
Passive.summary: Fizz can move through units and takes a flat amount of reduced damage from all sources

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Slippery AP assassin who dashes through targets with Q, dodges abilities with untargetable E, and sets up kills with shark R.
strengths: Strong vs melee and immobile mages
weaknesses: Weak early waveclear and trading before 3
Point-and-click CC after E ends punishes him
profile.curveNote: Needs E to trade safely; often farms until 3 or 6.

Q.notes: Dash applying on-hit effects (check if dodgeable)

R.notes: Fish skillshot attaches, shark knocks up

Passive.notes: Flat damage reduction; moves through units

profile.windowAgainst: E down (no dodge): use your CC/burst.
checks: Q on-hit application vs Jax E dodge
